name: calendar-shortcuts-google
title: DayCal
description: A fast Google Calendar schedule, menu bar, quick add, and event management extension for Raycast.
author: jonah_tweed

commands.name: schedule
commands.title: Schedule
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: View and manage your Google Calendar schedule directly in Raycast.

commands.name: enabled-calendars
commands.title: Enabled Calendars
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: Choose which Google calendars appear when Custom calendar selection is active.

commands.name: set-up-calendars
commands.title: Set up Calendars
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: Assign calendar roles and optional smart-routing keywords.

commands.name: add-personal-event
commands.title: Add Personal Event
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: Add an event to Personal with smart timed/all-day parsing and calendar checking.

commands.name: add-shared-event
commands.title: Add Shared Event
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: Add an event to your Shared / Partner calendar with smart timed/all-day parsing and calendar checking.

commands.name: add-work-event
commands.title: Add Work Event
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: Add an event to Work with smart timed/all-day parsing and calendar checking.

commands.name: menu-bar-settings
commands.title: Calendar Settings
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: Configure independent Schedule and menu-bar calendars and menu-bar filtering.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Calendar Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: Show current and upcoming Google Calendar events in the macOS menu bar.

commands.name: disconnect-google
commands.title: Disconnect Google Account
commands.subtitle: DayCal
commands.description: Disconnect Google Calendar and choose whether to keep or delete this account’s saved DayCal setup.

preferences.name: daysAhead
preferences.title: Schedule Range
preferences.description: How far ahead Schedule should load.

preferences.name: hideDeclined
preferences.title: Declined Events
preferences.description: Hide invitations that you have declined.
preferences.label: Hide declined events

preferences.name: calendarSelectionMode
preferences.title: Calendar Selection Mode
preferences.description: Choose which calendars DayCal uses. Custom is managed with the Enabled Calendars command.

preferences.name: menuBarMode
preferences.title: Show Events in Menu Bar
preferences.description: Choose when DayCal should appear in the macOS menu bar.

preferences.name: menuBarHeadlineStyle
preferences.title: Menu Bar Headline
preferences.description: Choose whether the menu bar shows smart timing status or only the current/next event title.

scripts.test: npm run test:parser && npm run test:routing && npm run test:refresh && npm run test:onboarding && npm run test:smart-status && npm run test:menu-row && npm run test:event-opening && npm run test:branding && npm run test:disconnect && npm run test:edit
